relationships.subject: Tetrahydrocannabinol
relationships.evidence_quote: THC, which acts as a partial agonist at CB1 and CB2 receptors

relationships.subject: Palmitoylethanolamide
relationships.evidence_quote: PEA which produces anti‐inflammatory effects mediated by activation of peroxisome proliferator‐activated receptor α and other targets

key_findings: Review: CB2 agonists and FAAH inhibitors have failed in clinical pain trials despite preclinical promise.
Dual-acting FAAH/COX-2 or FAAH/TRPV1 compounds may be a way forward.
